dataList.place:
Daguanyuan Sparring Grounds
大观园 公认武斗对练场

dataList.content:
What? Do you have something to say to my face?
什么。你有话要说吗？
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Yeah. Don't give my little brother your crap.
你，别擅自怂恿我弟弟产生没用的想法。

Your little... brother?
弟……弟？
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
You know who I'm talking about. Do you have any idea of the mess you left behind when you yoinked that kid away?
别装作不知道。就因为你突然把他带走，家里都乱套了！

<That buzzcut kid was... her little brother.>
<那个小光头……是她弟弟啊。>

You can barely even hold onto your seat, which you're about to lose soon anyway... And you have the gall to give him false hope?
你都软弱到快要下台了……却还给他徒劳的希望……

I know it's all just politics to you, but... kids really believe you, you know?
也许你只是说说而已……但小孩子是真会当真的。

... I heard from the kid that you seemed relieved upon hearing what I said.
你说得那么消极……但听那孩子说，你松了口气呢。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Told me you were happy for once to hear that he had a fun time, after being barred from playing with his friends with how things are in Hongyuan.
他告诉我，看到因鸿园动荡甚至都不能和朋友们一起玩的他久违地露出笑容，你很开心呢。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Sh-shut up.
闭、闭嘴。

Besides... it's not all just hot air.
而且……我也不只是说说而已。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
What…?
什么……？

I wasn't making an empty promise when I said I will change Hongyuan to be a place where everyone can live without fear.
我是真心想要创造一个令人无须畏惧的鸿园。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
And for that... I'm going to protect my seat of power, no matter what it takes.
为此……我无论如何都会守住家主之位。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
You'll fail.
你守不住的。

Not with you on my side.
如果你愿意帮助我，也许就可以。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
We all know what big sister Yuanchun's Hongyuan looks like. It'll be exactly the same in essence, and will be the same for the foreseeable future.
元春姐姐掌权的鸿园……不会有任何变化。以后也是如此。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Tell me. Are you sure you're okay with handing over that same burden we've carried all our lives to... your little siblings?
你难道想让你的弟弟妹妹们……也背负由我们背负一生的战斗吗？
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
... No, of course not.
……怎么可能。

Wang Qingshan left in a hurry.
王清山逃跑般离开了。

But... that look in her eyes told me that there was conflict brewing in her.
但……听到贾惜春的话后，她眼中明显凝着沉思。
